game.name: Shadows Of The Damned (Japan)(En,Ja)
game.desc: Shadows of the Damned is a horrific action game for Xbox 360. Garcia Hotspur, a demon hunter, goes in search of his sweetheart Paula, kidnapped by the Master of Demons, the terrible Fleming. Garcia will be able to count on the help of Johnson, a former demon capable of transforming into all kinds of weapons. It will be necessary to regularly go through the Darkness, a dangerous zone in which it is better not to stay too long.
